items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: So Peter Hone had nice work... Anything that was out there, he was a house band... And then we had work like at the metric club and then we had work like out the Ottoman Park and we used to play for those... So we, uh, that was about the year of 30, 32 or 33... I stayed with you on band.

ctx.x: My, my, my, my mother's sister, which is my auntie. We call, we call Aunt Bella. What is that name? Uh-huh. Well, she married her, my, my, my, my maiden name was Latoya, like my mother, but she married a Raphael. That's Peter, that's Peter, that's Peter Raphael's mother. You know, you know, Peter Raphael played drums. Got his lady cut off now. Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. Oh, that's my first cousin. Yeah?
Yeah. Did we get your father's name? I don't know that you gave his name.
